# TurboFix — AI Maintenance Control System for Manufacturing SMEs

> TurboFix is the AI-assisted maintenance control and breakdown decision platform built specifically for Indian manufacturing plants and SMEs. It eliminates unplanned machine downtime, repeat breakdowns, and paper logbook chaos through 10-second QR breakdown reporting, photo-verified repair closure, and 5-Why Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

## Key Information
- **Category**: Industrial AI, Plant Reliability Software, Maintenance Management, CMMS
- **Target Audience**: Factory Owners, Plant Directors, Maintenance Heads, Shift Supervisors, and Technicians
- **Primary Markets**: Indian Manufacturing SMEs (Auto-ancillary, Engineering, Plastics, Textile, Pharma, Chemical)
- **Deployment**: Cloud-native PWA, AWS Mumbai (ap-south-1) Data Residency
- **Pricing**: Simple per-machine monthly plans starting at ₹499 to ₹699 / machine / month (15% annual discount)
- **Website**: https://turbofix.co.in/

## Core Platform Capabilities

### 1. 10-Second QR Breakdown Reporting
- Operators scan durable machine QR stickers with mobile camera (no app download required).
- Select symptom or attach voice/photo note.
- Automatic SLA alert dispatch to shift technician via WhatsApp API.

### 2. Verified 4-Step Repair Loop
- Technicians receive structured mobile work orders with spare parts checklist.
- Mandatory Lock-Out Tag-Out (LOTO) safety verification before starting work.
- Mandatory photo/video proof of repair before submission.
- Supervisor sign-off & 5-Why RCA before ticket closure.

### 3. Living Machine Memory (AI Logbook Extraction)
- Converts handwritten paper registers, PDFs, Excel sheets, job cards, and manuals into structured machine memory.
- Human-in-the-loop: AI creates a draft; Maintenance Head must review and approve records before future AI context indexing.

### 4. Executive Control Board
- Real-time MTTR (Mean Time to Repair) and MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures) metrics.
- Breakdown SLA risk alerts and downtime cost calculation in ₹ Lakhs.
- Critical spare part reorder warnings before stockouts cause production halts.
